bullets: Added a Discord status feature to the desktop app that displays "Playing Freebuff" when enabled.
Added the ability to reference specific artifact types like docs or slides within text prompts.
Added margin and stroke pattern options to design nodes for spacing and dashed or dotted borders.
Added a lifetime usage summary to the account that tracks all tokens used across past days.
Added a new referral placement for the year card in Freebuff with actions for sharing or downloading.
Changed mobile apps to hide the AI model picker, keeping only standard coding and chat options.
Fixed double-counting in lifetime token totals by merging archived and live data sources.
Added a safety check that blocks Reddit campaign briefs requesting moderation evasion or hidden sponsorship.
Added support for Reddit campaigns that target a subreddit link instead of a fixed post link.
Added an internal tracking step for website deployment outcomes and site invite sharing moments.
